descGu: Pizza ના ટુકડા! Half, quarter શીખો.
descEn: Slice the pizza! Learn half and quarter.
descDa: Skær pizzaen! Lær om halv og kvart.

teacherGuide.conceptGu: અપૂર્ણાંક = whole ના ભાગ. Half (½) = 2 equal pieces, 1 લો. Quarter (¼) = 4 equal pieces, 1 લો. Equal size = most important concept. Pizza, chocolate bar, paper fold — physical demonstration essential.
teacherGuide.conceptEn: Fractions = equal parts of a whole. Half=1/2, Quarter=1/4. Equal size is key.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: Brøker er lige store dele af en helhed. Halv er 1 af 2 lige store dele (1/2), kvart er 1 af 4 lige store dele (1/4). Lige store størrelser er afgørende.
teacherGuide.storyGu: 'Yuval, pizza ના 2 equal slices — તમે 1 લો = half! 4 equal slices — 1 લો = quarter! Computer graphics, screen divide — same fraction math use!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: Yuval has a pizza with 2 equal slices. Taking 1 is a half! If 4 slices, taking 1 is a quarter.
teacherGuide.storyDa: Yuval deler en pizza i 4 lige store stykker. Han spiser 3 af stykkerne. Han har spist tre fjerdedele (3/4) af pizzaen!
teacherGuide.scriptGu: 'Paper fold! Half fold = 2 equal parts. Fold again = 4 equal parts = quarters. Open and see the lines!'
teacherGuide.scriptEn: Fold a paper in half to get 2 equal parts. Fold again to get 4 quarters. Unfold and explore.
teacherGuide.scriptDa: Fold et stykke papir på midten for at få 2 lige store dele. Fold det igen for at få 4 kvardele (kvart-dele). Fold det ud og tæl dem.
teacherGuide.tipsGu: 💡 Chocolate bar break in half — count squares each side same? Paper fold and unfold — see equal parts. Apple cut! Physical = best.
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 Break a chocolate bar or cut an apple to show halves. Fold paper to show quarters. Hands-on is best!
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Knæk en chokoladebar i to eller skær et æble for at vise halvdele. Fold papir for at vise fjerdedele. Fysiske eksempler virker bedst!

questions.textEn: Pizza cut into 2 equal pieces. Take 1 piece = ?
questions.textDa: En pizza skæres i 2 lige store dele. Hvad kaldes 1 del?
questions.hintDa: 1 ud af 2 lige store dele kaldes en halv!

questions.textEn: Chocolate bar cut into 4 equal pieces. Take 1 = ?
questions.textDa: En chokoladebar skæres i 4 lige store dele. Hvad kaldes 1 del?
questions.hintDa: 1 ud af 4 lige store dele kaldes en kvart!

questions.textEn: Pizza has 4 slices. You eat 3. What fraction did you eat?
questions.textDa: En pizza har 4 stykker. Du spiser 3 stykker. Hvor stor en brøkdel spiste du?
questions.hintDa: 3 ud af 4 dele kaldes tre fjerdedele!

questions.textGu: 🍫 Yuval ના 16 chocolates. Half friend ને આપ્યા. Yuval પાસે કેટલા?
questions.textEn: Yuval has 16 chocolates. Gives half to a friend. How many does Yuval keep?
questions.textDa: Yuval har 16 chokolader. Han giver halvdelen til en ven. Hvor mange chokolader beholder Yuval?
